about: The cells of EXPERIMENT.md 7 (DRAFT: n are the draft counts of section 7, frozen only after the pilot, PILOT.md). Input of hold_rs.sh (what to run) and score.py (planned scored trials per cell@build). kind: rs -> run_rs.sh (the 4-rank restore workload gin_rs), reg -> ../../../remaining/run_mr_hr.sh (gin-remaining's 4-rank runner, the regression cells). build: rs (restore research, ~/rs-bundle/lib/rs), hk (gpu-detect research, ~/gi-bundle/gin_ts2/hk, read only: the no-restore control). env: the cell's runner variables (each value one argument; spaces kept). Pilot holds (P*) are never scored; P3 holds the spare's pilot checks (its strace, the two negative replays), cells named by description, not section-7 cells. The cost cells are in 'cost' (run_cost.sh through hold_rs.sh's interleave). Cell names keep the search keys of sections 3 and 7. The draft cell of the no-spare fallback is split (supervisor decision, 2026-10-12): rs4_kill3_nospare = no spare registered (never armed: the fail-fast reaction as hk) and rs4_kill3_spareabsent = a spare registered, ready, then killed by its recorded PID before the rank dies (hold, then fallback). driver (2026-10-12 design change, user): the build each cell runs: gin_rs (this layer's headers with NCCL_GIN_RESTORE_DEVICE; every restore cell), gin_rs_nomacro (this layer's headers without the macro; Resume must refuse on every rank), gin_rs_hk (hk's headers; the no-restore control), mr/ff and mr/hold (gin-remaining's gin_mr.cu against this layer's headers without and with the macro; the hold regression rows use mr/hold).

regression_orig.about: The original cell each regression cell repeats, for score.py's status (gin-remaining's status4 as hr) and its verdict (gpu-detect's RG8/RG9 form of gin-remaining's RG8 and DG1+DG3 at n=5).

cost.about: cost_<metric>_<arm>_<node> (run_cost.sh). Each family runs in holds per receiving node (and per metric for the log family: COST-log-<node>-<metric>): for k = 1-6 the metric's arms back to back, the first arm alternating with k. Scored key cost_<metric>_<arm>@<lib>, the receiving nodes kept apart in score.py (planned n_per_arm per node). The log family (supervisor decision 2026-10-12) uses the macro-built driver in every arm and the library's measurement mode (NCCL_GIN_RESTORE_LOG_MEASURE publishes the side table without Resume; NCCL_GIN_RESTORE_LOG_MEASURE_LOG=0|1): off is fail-fast, ua-hold the hold path without the log, on/sampled/full with the log and its checksum. The fail-fast branch measures both builds of this layer: ffb-rs (no macro, judged: must not separate from hk) and ffb-rs-macro (reported). The 4 KiB get arm of lat_ff_branch is not covered (gin_ts2 has no get latency mode).

log.search_key: cost_log (on, sampled, full against off) and cost_unarmed (ua-hold against off)
